status: design proposal only; not existing engine schema
colorSpace: sRGB hex; lighting and interpolation in linear RGB

contrastDefinition.plusMinusMeaning: symmetric excursion relative to base; ±5% means 10% base-normalized difference between extrema
contrastDefinition.authority: target values apply before 8-bit rounding; roundedHexDeltaYPercent reports exact consequence of exported hex
contrastDefinition.screenClaim: Starting targets for phone validation; no measured legibility or physical wetness claim
contrastDefinition.namedTonePolicy: road-patch/crack-seal neutral palettes are independent standalone materials; featureTones relative to road-asphalt govern repairs on that road

rigs.note: studio assumptions; production uses engine solar model

appearanceTransform.warning: art-direction display swatches; do not feed lit references back into albedo

contact.doubleOcclusionPolicy: combine ambient visibility via min(existing,new), not multiply; exclude direct sun

parkway.policy: omit if mapped alignment has no space; never displace sidewalk

snow.stretchRequires: supplied clearing/traffic/plow state or explicit authored demo
snow.contrastMeaning: overlay colour luminance relative to fresh snow, dirty base relative to plowed bank; exact after hex rounding

leaves.regionMiami: sparse evergreen turnover; no blanket northern fall carpet

performance.optionalGeometryPolicy: subset of shared remaining reserve; reduce other embellishment allocations if combined reserve would exceed 35k
performance.texturePolicy: authored masks/procedural bakes only; no photographic albedo
